title: Look into Kīlauea’s caldera
description: Stand at an officially open overlook in Hawaiʻi Volcanoes National Park and take in the scale of Kīlauea’s summit caldera. Steam, layered rock, and a changing volcanic landscape are compelling even when no lava is visible. When eruption activity is safely in view, the experience can become more dramatic; park alerts determine where visitors may stand.
teaser: See Kīlauea from an open park overlook.
goodToKnow: An eruption is never promised. Check current park alerts, air quality, viewpoint access and visibility before visiting.
whyItMightDelightYou: The landscape makes Earth feel active under your feet, whether the volcano is quiet or visibly erupting.
